note: Sites left out of Watchfloor's data (31 Oct 2026). Measured on the 29 and 30 Oct 2026 cycle files (~30,000 matched GDELT articles a day): removing all of these changed any zone's attention count by 0-3% (critical minerals 9%, 3 stories), because story grouping and the headline filter already absorb most of them. They are left out so story cards, outlet counts and stored rows are not padded with non-news, press releases and copies. GDELT rows are checked at ingest (pipeline/cycle.py) and again when a day is built (pipeline/daily.py); Google News items by their ' - Publisher' tail at ingest (pipeline/feeds.py). Articles a day are GDELT articles matched to a zone or topic.
